stage1.impression: A clean, graphic range shot: eight tinted acrylic speakers in a row on pale paper, backlit so each throws a coloured pool toward the lens. The idea reads at once and the coloured shadows are the best thing in it, but the shadows are razor-hard, long and mostly neutral grey, they fan out and crop at both frame edges, the cabinet fronts are murky rather than glowing, and the grey cove band behind the horns flattens their silhouettes. It reads as a careful CG render, not yet a photograph.

blocking_9: Shadows read as soft-edged photographic shadows from a real source (penumbra growing with distance), not hard CG cut-outs
Neutral grey shadow cores no longer outweigh the coloured pools; the coloured light is the dominant mass in the lower half
Outer shadows do not fan out and crop at the left and right frame edges
Cabinet fronts glow with transmitted colour (each cabinet body lum_median roughly 80-120) instead of reading muddy; the smoked black keeps detail without crushing
No visible grey cove band behind the horns; the background reads as one continuous sweep
Paper shows a believable real-scale tooth and faint unevenness so the set reads as photographed

defects.what: Shadows are knife-edged with a hard grey core (lum ~95) from a 0.25 m source; they read as CG cut-outs and their grey mass dominates the coloured pools
Red and orange shadows fan outward, overlap each other and run off the left edge
Black and clear speakers' shadows fan out and are cropped by the right edge
Darker grey cove band (lum ~221-229 vs 241 above) right behind the horns, cutting through their silhouettes, worst behind the water-clear horn
Green cabinet front murky (lum_median 63), colour reads dull rather than lit-through
Smoked black cabinet crushed (lum_median 19, crush 3.4%); its parts barely read
Water-clear speaker reads flat neutral grey (lum_median 137, R=G=B), not clear acrylic
Small clipped amber hot spots in the yellow speaker's floor caustic (clip 0.32%)
Large empty band between the title zone and the horn tops; the range sits small in frame
Paper foreground is smooth and featureless; no visible tooth at this size

changes.problem: The key is a tiny disc, so every shadow is knife-edged and reads as CG.

evidence.measured: shadow edges visually 1-2 px wide at the cabinet and only slightly softer at the far end; grey core lum_median 94.8 against paper ~220

change.to: 0.8 m disc (same position and intensity at target)

changes.expected: Shadows keep their shape near the feet and soften with distance; the colour pools gain a gradient edge of 6-12 px at the far end.

changes.problem: The key sits close behind the line, so the outer shadows fan outward, overlap and run off both frame edges.

evidence.measured: red and orange shadows converge and leave the frame at x=0; right side similar at x=1280 (1200-1280 x 460-520 lum_median 101, shadow)

change.to: (0, 14.0, 9.5) aimed at (0, -2, 0), irradiance at target held at 4.4 W/m2

changes.expected: Shadows run nearly parallel toward the lens, slightly shorter; the outermost pools stay inside the frame with paper visible to their outside.

changes.problem: Neutral grey shadow cores are heavier than the coloured pools, so the floor reads grey-and-colour instead of colour.

evidence.measured: grey core lum_median 94.8, RGB 92/95/100; coloured pools lum 127-157

changes.expected: Grey cores lift to about 120-140 so they read as soft absence of light; the coloured pools hold contrast against them.

changes.problem: The coloured pools are pale; ambient from the dome and silk washes the key's colour out.

evidence.measured: blue pool RGB median 118/164/201; violet pool 136/121/161; green 130/147/126 (barely green)

change.to: sky 0.4, key 5.5 W/m2, exposure -1.9 -> -2.2 EV to hold the paper

changes.expected: Pools gain saturation: blue pool red channel drops below ~100 while blue stays above 190; green pool reads clearly green.

changes.problem: Cabinet fronts are murky and the smoked black crushes, so the acrylic does not glow.

evidence.measured: green cabinet lum_median 63; black cabinet (1080,300,1175,455) lum_median 19, crush 3.4%

changes.expected: Cabinet bodies read lit-through with colour; black keeps its internals visible.

changes.problem: A darker grey cove band sits right behind the horns and muddies their silhouettes.

evidence.measured: lum_median 225 against 241 above; profile y 200-360 falls 241 -> 229 -> 221 at the horn line

changes.expected: The sweep reads continuous behind the horns, within ~8 levels of the wall above.

changes.problem: The range sits small with an empty band between the title zone and the horns.

evidence.measured: speakers span y 240-455 (34% of height); 112 px of empty wall below the title fifth

change.to: (0, -11.0, 2.2), 58 mm, extra shift adjusted so horn tops sit just below y = 0.25 frame height

changes.expected: Speakers fill about 42% of frame height; the title fifth stays clean; slightly lower eye gives the cabinets more presence.

changes.problem: The paper reads as a smooth CG plane in the foreground.

evidence.measured: lum_range 39 is all vignette gradient; no visible tooth at this size

change.to: tooth 0.3 at 1.2 mm, mottle 0.04, plus a very faint large-scale undulation (2-3 mm over 1 m)

changes.expected: Grazing key light picks out paper tooth in the foreground and along the pools' edges without visible tiling.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the dominance of the black driver silhouette inside each horn
out_of_scope.why: It is a part of the speaker; it reads as a black blob at the top of every unit and competes with the horn's colour, but the speaker is fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Make the water-clear finish read clearer than flat grey
out_of_scope.why: Its material is fixed; only lighting (c5) can help.
